holder-quote: “[Armform]. This is my duelist form. I can make them normal as well. And this—let go, Ksmvr?”
effect-quote: If Yvlon had been wearing her breastplate, it would have been a perfect fit. The [Armsmistress] regarded her hand, now a gauntlet, and held it out. Keldrass shook his head, but Ksmvr touched the arm softly. The woman looked around, a crooked smile on her face.
